joint_coordinate.display: deg for angular axes; distance for linear axes
joint_coordinate.description: Angular joint columns use degrees in both reads and writes; linear columns use distance.

joint_rate.display: deg / sec for angular axes; distance / sec for linear axes
joint_rate.description: Angular joint columns use degrees in both reads and writes; linear columns use distance.

joint_effort.display: mass * distance^2 / sec^2 for angular axes; mass * distance / sec^2 for linear axes
joint_effort.description: Generalized effort is torque on rotational axes and force on translational axes; it receives no degree conversion.

joint_stiffness.display: mass * distance^2 / (sec^2 * deg) (angular force drive); mass / sec^2 (linear force drive); rad / (deg * sec^2) (angular acceleration drive); 1 / sec^2 (linear acceleration drive)
joint_stiffness.description: The SDK gain is per rad or per rad/sec. The runtime converts the denominator to deg for angular columns, including acceleration drives; it does not convert the output acceleration numerator. Angular joint columns use degrees in both reads and writes; linear columns use distance.

joint_damping.display: mass * distance^2 / (sec * deg) (angular force drive); mass / sec (linear force drive); rad / (deg * sec) (angular acceleration drive); 1 / sec (linear acceleration drive)
joint_damping.description: The SDK gain is per rad or per rad/sec. The runtime converts the denominator to deg for angular columns, including acceleration drives; it does not convert the output acceleration numerator. Angular joint columns use degrees in both reads and writes; linear columns use distance.

joint_armature.display: mass * distance^2 for angular axes; mass for linear axes

effort_per_rate.display: mass * distance^2 / (sec * deg) for angular axes; mass / sec for linear axes
effort_per_rate.description: Angular joint columns use degrees in both reads and writes; linear columns use distance.

rate_per_effort.display: deg * sec / (mass * distance^2) for angular axes; sec / mass for linear axes
rate_per_effort.description: Angular joint columns use degrees in both reads and writes; linear columns use distance.

jacobian.display: row velocity / column generalized velocity: dimensionless, distance / rad, or rad / distance
jacobian.description: Maps generalized velocities to link linear and angular velocities. Angular columns use rad/sec, including floating-base rotation; linear columns use distance/sec. No degree conversion.

mass_matrix.display: row generalized effort / column generalized acceleration: mass, mass * distance, or mass * distance^2 (rad treated as dimensionless)
mass_matrix.description: Maps generalized accelerations to force/torque. Angular accelerations use rad/sec^2, with radians dimensionless in the mechanical mass/inertia units. No degree conversion.

centroidal_momentum_matrix.display: matrix: mass, mass * distance, or mass * distance^2; final bias column: mass * distance / sec^2 (linear rows), mass * distance^2 / sec^2 (angular rows)
centroidal_momentum_matrix.description: The matrix maps generalized velocities to linear/angular momentum; its final column is a bias force/torque for the momentum derivative, not momentum. Angular velocities use rad/sec, with radians dimensionless in the mechanical mass/inertia units. No degree conversion.

tendon_coordinate.display: deg for unit authored-gearing angular fixed tendons; distance for unit authored-gearing linear fixed tendons; coefficient-defined for mixed axes
tendon_coordinate.description: Fixed-tendon length is offset + sum(SDK coefficient * SDK joint position). For revolute axes, parsing and gearing updates multiply authored gearing by rad-to-deg, so unit authored gearing yields degrees. Mixed axes or dimensionful gearing determine their own common coordinate unit.

tendon_stiffness.display: mass * distance^2 / (sec^2 * deg) for unit authored-gearing angular fixed tendons; mass / sec^2 for unit authored-gearing linear fixed tendons
tendon_stiffness.description: For arbitrary fixed-tendon coefficients, joint effort = stiffness * coordinate error * reciprocalCoefficient. Both position and force coefficients determine the unit; mixed-axis configurations require their declared coefficient units. The angular variant assumes unit authored gearing and unit force coefficient; the SDK gearing includes rad-to-deg.

tendon_damping.display: mass * distance^2 / (sec * deg) for unit authored-gearing angular fixed tendons; mass / sec for unit authored-gearing linear fixed tendons
tendon_damping.description: For arbitrary fixed-tendon coefficients, joint effort = damping * tendon coordinate rate * reciprocalCoefficient. Both position and force coefficients determine the unit; mixed-axis configurations require their declared coefficient units. The angular variant assumes unit authored gearing and unit force coefficient; the SDK gearing includes rad-to-deg.

wrench.display: force xyz: mass * distance / sec^2; torque xyz: mass * distance^2 / sec^2; application point xyz: distance

ground_plane.display: normal xyz: dimensionless; plane distance: distance

kinematic_target.display: position xyz: distance; active flag w: dimensionless

elasticity_damping.display: sec for volume materials; 1 / sec for surface materials

spatial_force.display: force xyz: mass * distance / sec^2; torque xyz: mass * distance^2 / sec^2

culling_box_write.display: enable flag: dimensionless; min/max xyz: distance
culling_box_write.description: Seven scalar elements: enable (0 to clear, 1 to store), min x/y/z, max x/y/z. Readback contains only the six distance values.
